summary: Revised implementation plan for CRM Outreach module based on KI handoff guide. Replaces campaign-centric approach with lead-centric architecture. Phase 1: New Supabase schema (crm_outreach_leads, crm_email_log, crm_email_templates), rebuilt Outreach UI with 3 sub-tabs (Leads, Discovery, Emails), seed templates from existing HTML files. Phase 2: Deploy FastAPI on VPS Megahost_02 for Gmail API sending and lead discovery. Includes migration strategy to drop old Phase 1 tables.
